parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Good morning. Thank you for calling Getaway Tours. I'm Sandra. How can I help you today? Hi Sandra. I've got a lot of questions, but can you first tell me your office hours?
Sure. We're open from 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. Thanks, Sandra. I saw your article in my favorite magazine last month, and I'd like more information about the different tours.
We have gotten a lot of calls about that article. I'm not surprised. Is it true that if I book a tour, the prices start at only $1,100 per person?
Yes. That's a special offer for this month. Normally, they're from $1,400 going up to $2,000, and it includes accommodation and meals. This offer is for any of our 36 different bicycling tours.
Well, I am definitely interested in the bicycling tours, but I thought there were only 30. Are all of them for a week?
Most of them. If bicycling is not your thing, we also have walking tours to choose from.
That's a lot of options. Are you aware that our trips all begin on Tuesday?
That's great. It would give me Monday to pack. How do you suggest I choose from so many options?
Yes. It is tough to make a choice.
I would love to hear about your most popular tours.
I'll start with the bicycling tours since you said that was your main interest. My wife and I are not in great shape for a hard ride. Do you have rides that are at the beginner level?
Sure. There's our Florida trip. That's 14 nights, but I'd recommend our holiday on the east coast of the US in an area known as the Autumn Route, which is just 6 nights. With short, leisurely routes on trails by the Riverside and through the forest, you have plenty of time to explore the landscape during your holiday.
Wow. Seeing the changing colors of the leaves would be amazing.
Yes, that's right. You also have the option to stop at some outstanding homes and see their gardens. Whichever cycling holiday you choose, you usually spend two nights at each hotel and always have plenty of time to explore, rest, and sightsee as you wish.
Could you tell me about one of your moderate rides? You never know, maybe my wife and I will get into enough shape to be able to do one.
Well, let me see. Oh, this trip is actually 10 nights long. It travels through lots of Southern California. The ride begins on a mountain trail and finally brings you down to the coastal roads.
Oh, yes. I see that here on your website. Oh, that looks amazing. I like that we would have the opportunity to try some of the local cuisine.
Yes. The cuisine in this area makes lavish use of colorful local produce. And then, you know, the great weather of this region is a great feature by itself.
Do we stay in hotels on this trip?
You stay in hotels most of the way until the end. When you stay on a farm overlooking the sea, that's always really popular.
Wow. Both trips sound fabulous. How far in advance do I have to make reservations?

analyses.content: 男生问起步价是否仅为 $1,100，Sandra 确认这是本月的特别优惠（special offer）。
Is it true that if I book a tour, the prices start at only $1,100 per person? Yes. That's a special offer for this month. Normally, they're from $1,400 going up to $2,000...
你可能听到 1,400 或 2,000 就想填，但录音明确说那是“通常价格（Normally）”，题目问的是本月最便宜的价格。
This offer is for any of our 36 different bicycling tours. Well, I am definitely interested in the bicycling tours, but I thought there were only 30.
男生说他以为只有 30 个，这只是他的错误印象，不要被这个数字带跑。
Sandra 明确表示优惠适用于所有的 36 个不同的自行车旅行项目。
Are all of them for a week? Most of them.
题目限制填词，虽然听到 "a" 后面可能想填名词，但要确保填入的是表示时长的词 "week"。
男生问是否所有行程都是一个 week（星期），Sandra 回答“绝大多数是（Most of them）”。
If bicycling is not your thing, we also have walking tours to choose from.
听到 "choose from" 就要警觉前面的选项，不要因为 bicycling 听得太熟就忽略了另一个选项。
Sandra 介绍说如果不喜欢骑行，公司还有 walking（徒步/步行）旅行可供选择。
Are you aware that our trips all begin on Tuesday? That's great. It would give me Monday to pack.
男生提到 Monday 是用来收拾行李的（pack），不是出发时间，千万别填错。
Sandra 确认所有的旅行都在 Tuesday（周二）开始。

analyses.content: 针对美国东海岸的行程（Eastern United States），Sandra 推荐的 "Autumn Route" 只有 6 个晚上。
That's 14 nights, but I'd recommend our holiday on the east coast of the US in an area known as the Autumn Route, which is just 6 nights.
注意区分干扰项，Florida 之旅是 14 晚，但题目表格对应的是东部路线（Autumn Route on the east coast）。
With short, leisurely routes on trails by the Riverside and through the forest, you have plenty of time to explore the landscape during your holiday.
Riverside 和 forest 是并列关系，听到 and 前后的词要迅速抓取。
录音提到路线很悠闲，穿过河边（Riverside）和 forest（森林）。
You also have the option to stop at some outstanding homes and see their gardens.
注意复数，homes 是复数，对应的 gardens 通常也是复数，漏听 "s" 会扣分。
录音说你可以停下来参观杰出的住宅（homes）并看看它们的 gardens（花园）。
The ride begins on a mountain trail and finally brings you down to the coastal roads.
注意词性，roads 是名词，前面需要填形容词 coastal，不要填成名词 coast。
针对南加州（Southern California）的行程，录音说从山路开始，最终把你带到 coastal（沿海）公路上。
You stay in hotels most of the way until the end. When you stay on a farm overlooking the sea, that's always really popular.
不要听到 sea 就填上去，sea 是农场看到的景色（overlooking the sea），住的地方是 farm。
录音提到虽然大部分时间住酒店，但最后会住在面朝大海的 farm（农场）里。
